saveFailed: The setting could not be saved.

page.title: Settings
page.intro: Every option and every prompt Ylide uses, in one place. Changes are saved when you leave a field.

validation.url: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.

language.label: Language
language.hint: System uses the language of your operating system, currently {{language}}.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: System follows the light or dark mode of your operating system.

updates.title: Version and updates
updates.label: Updates
updates.notChecked: Ylide has not checked for updates since it started.
updates.disabled: Checking for updates is switched off under Network and privacy.
updates.failed: The update check did not work: {{message}}
updates.handedOver: The installer is running. Ylide closes and then starts again.
updates.ready: The update is downloaded and checked. Installing restarts Ylide.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: How code looks in the editor.

fontFamily.label: Font
fontFamily.hint: A CSS font list. If the first font is not installed, the next one is used.

lineHeight.label: Line height
lineHeight.hint: Space between lines as a multiple of the font size.

tabSize.label: Tab width
tabSize.hint: How many spaces a tab character takes up.

wordWrap.label: Wrap long lines
wordWrap.hint: Breaks lines at the edge of the editor instead of scrolling sideways.

minimap.label: Show minimap
minimap.hint: A small overview of the whole file on the right edge.

chat.title: Chat and prompts
chat.description: The instructions the model receives in the chat and for inline edits.

systemPrompt.label: Chat system prompt
systemPrompt.hint: Sent at the start of every chat conversation, before your messages and attachments.

contextBudget.label: Context budget for attachments
contextBudget.hint: Upper limit for files, folders and selections attached with @, currently {{tokens}} tokens. Larger attachments are shortened.

chat.inlineDescription: Used when you select code and press Ctrl+K.

inlinePrompt.label: Inline edit prompt
inlinePrompt.hint: Sent with the selected code, the surrounding lines and your instruction.

history.label: Save chats
history.hint: Keeps the chats of each project on this computer, in Ylide's data folder, so you can reopen them. They are never sent anywhere.

deleteAll.label: Saved chats
deleteAll.hint: Deletes the saved chats of all projects from this computer.
deleteAll.confirmBody: The saved chats of every project are deleted from this computer. This cannot be undone.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: What agents may do without asking, how they run commands, and the roles and messages they work with.
agents.approvalsDescription: Agents always read on their own. These settings decide when they need your approval for changes.

ask.title: Ask first
ask.body: Every edit, deletion and command waits for your approval.

autoSafe.title: Safe steps
autoSafe.body: Edits run automatically and can be undone with checkpoints. Deletions and commands always ask first, except allowed commands.

autonomous.title: Autonomous
autonomous.body: Everything runs automatically, except what the two switches below keep for your approval.

agents.onlyAutonomous: Only applies in the autonomous mode. Ask first and Safe steps always ask before deletions and commands.

confirmCommands.label: Confirm commands
confirmCommands.hint: Ask before an agent runs a command that is not on the allowed list below.
confirmCommands.off: Agents can run any command without asking. Commands that destroy data outside the project stay blocked.

confirmDeletes.label: Confirm deletions
confirmDeletes.hint: Ask before an agent deletes a file or folder.
confirmDeletes.off: Agents can delete files without asking. You can restore them from a checkpoint.

commands.title: Allowed commands
commands.description: A command runs without asking when it starts with one of these prefixes: cargo test also allows cargo test --release. A command that chains or redirects with &&, ||, ;, |, `, $(, > or < always asks, even when it starts with an allowed prefix.
commands.askMode: In the ask first mode, allowed commands also wait for your approval.
commands.empty: No commands are allowed yet. Agents ask before every command.

problem.duplicate: This prefix is already in the list.

reviewEnabled.label: Review every task
reviewEnabled.hint: The reviewer checks each finished task's changes and can send it back to the coder.

maxReviewRounds.label: Review rounds per task
maxReviewRounds.hint: How often the reviewer may request changes before the task counts as done.

updateProjectNotes.label: Keep project knowledge in AGENTS.md
updateProjectNotes.hint: After each run, the orchestrator writes what it learned about the project (commands that worked, structure, conventions, decisions) into Ylide’s own section of AGENTS.md in the project folder. Your own text in the file stays as it is. Agents and chat always read the file when it exists.

agents.shellDescription: How run_command starts commands in the project folder.

shellProgram.label: Shell program
shellProgram.hint: For example powershell.exe, cmd.exe, bash or zsh.

shellArgs.label: Shell arguments
shellArgs.hint: One argument per line, placed before the command.

shellTimeout.label: Default time limit
shellTimeout.hint: A command that runs longer is stopped. Agents can ask for a longer limit per command.

shellOutput.label: Output limit
shellOutput.hint: Longer output is shortened in the middle before the agent sees it.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Each agent works in a role: its system prompt, the tools it may use and how many steps it may take.
roles.name: Name
roles.idHint: Used in plans and when agents ask each other. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.

idProblem.format: Start with a lowercase letter; use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).
idProblem.taken: Another role already uses this ID.

roles.descriptionHint: The orchestrator reads this to decide which role gets a task.
roles.systemPromptHint: Sent at the start of every task this role works on.
roles.toolsHint: The role can only call the tools that are checked. Writes, deletions and commands still follow the approval settings above.
roles.unknownTools: Also allowed, but not known to this version: {{tools}}
roles.temperatureHint: Higher values give more varied answers. Leave empty to use the value the model recommends.
roles.maxStepsHint: Most model turns per task. The task stops when the limit is reached.
roles.builtinHint: Built-in roles can be changed and reset, but not deleted.
roles.customHint: Custom roles can be assigned tasks by the orchestrator.
roles.deleteBody: Plans that assign tasks to {{id}} can no longer use it. This cannot be undone.
roles.startFromHint: Copies the system prompt, tools and limits, which you can change afterwards.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.description: The messages Ylide itself sends to agents during a run. Fields in curly braces are filled in automatically; insert them with the buttons.
templates.unknown: Not filled in, sent as written: {{names}}

planner.label: Planning request
planner.hint: Sent to the orchestrator with your request, the available roles and the project structure.

coderTask.label: Task for the coder
coderTask.hint: Sent to the role that works on a task, with the team's progress.

reviewerTask.label: Review request
reviewerTask.hint: Sent to the reviewer with the coder's summary and the changes as a diff.

feedback.label: Requested changes
feedback.hint: Sent back to the coder when the reviewer requests changes.

question.label: Question from another agent
question.hint: Sent when one agent asks another for help.

continue.label: Continue
continue.hint: Sent when a model answers with text instead of calling a tool. Has no fields.

repeatedFailure.label: Repeated failure
repeatedFailure.hint: Sent when an agent repeats the same failing tool call. Has no fields.

notes.label: Project knowledge
notes.hint: Sent to the orchestrator after a run, to update Ylide’s section of AGENTS.md.

network.title: Network and privacy
network.statementBody: Ylide does not collect usage data, has no sign-in and never uploads your code. It connects to the internet only for the five purposes below, and only while they are switched on. Your prompts and files go to the model on this computer, or to the external server you set up under Advanced.
network.allowedDescription: Switch off any of these and Ylide will not make that request.

registry.label: Model list updates
registry.hint: Checks for a newer list of models at startup and when you refresh it, from the address below.

registryUrl.label: Model list address
registryUrl.hint: Where the model list is downloaded from. It names the model files and the runtime programs Ylide downloads, with their checksums. The list at the official address must be signed by Ylide. A list at another address is checked against Ylide's signature when a signature file (models.json.sig) lies next to it, and is used as it is without one.

models.label: Model downloads
models.hint: Downloads model files from Hugging Face (huggingface.co) when you start a download.

runtimes.label: Runtime downloads
runtimes.hint: Downloads inference runtimes such as the CUDA pack from GitHub (github.com) when you install one.

network.logDescription: Every request Ylide has made since it started. New requests appear here as they happen.
network.logFailed: The network log could not be loaded: {{message}}
network.logEmpty: No requests yet. Nothing has left this computer since Ylide started.

updates.label: Check for updates
updates.hint: Asks ylide.app once at startup whether a newer version of Ylide exists. Only the version number is sent. The update itself is downloaded only when you install it.

skills.label: Skill downloads
skills.hint: Lists and downloads skills from GitHub (api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com) when you add, install or update them on the Skills page. Off until you allow it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Storage, the local model server, an external server and the folders Ylide uses.

modelsDir.label: Models folder
modelsDir.hint: Downloaded and imported models are stored here.

advanced.serverDescription: Options for llama-server, which runs the model on this computer.

slots.label: Parallel requests
slots.hint: How many requests the main model handles at the same time, for example an agent and the chat. Slots share the context.

context.label: Context size
context.hint: Leave empty to use the size recommended for the model.
context.hintModel: Leave empty to use the recommended size for {{model}}: {{tokens}} tokens (at most {{max}}).

runtime.label: Runtime
runtime.hint: Which installed llama.cpp build runs the model.

extraArgs.label: Extra llama-server arguments
extraArgs.hint: One argument per line, appended last to the command line. Wrong arguments can keep the model from starting.

autostart.label: Start model on launch
autostart.hint: Starts the chosen model when Ylide opens.

advanced.appliesOnRestart: Changes to the model server apply the next time the model starts.

endpoint.title: External server
endpoint.description: Use an OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama, LM Studio or another llama-server instead of the built-in runtime. Your prompts and code are then sent to that address.

enabled.label: Use the external server
enabled.hint: Chat, inline edits and agents use this server instead of a local model.

baseUrl.label: Address
baseUrl.hint: The base URL of the API, usually ending in /v1.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.hint: Optional. Stored in the settings file on this computer and sent only to this server.

model.label: Model
model.hint: The model name the server expects. Leave empty to use the server's default.

context.label: Context size
context.hint: The context window of the external model. Leave empty to assume {{tokens}} tokens.

endpoint.connectHint: Connect saves these values and switches to the external server.

about.title: About Ylide
about.description: The version and the folders Ylide uses on this computer.

modelsPage.title: Models
modelsPage.intro: What runs on this computer, what is installed and what you can download. Every model runs locally.

active.title: Active model
active.description: The model that answers in the chat, rewrites code and runs agents.
active.noneSelected: {{model}} {{quant}} is chosen for chat and agents. Start it to begin.
active.noneEndpoint: The external server {{url}} is switched on. Connect to use it.
active.noneChoose: Choose an installed model below, or download one from the catalog.

unknown.label: Not tested
unknown.body: Ylide tests tool calling shortly after the model is ready. Until then agents may work less reliably.

native.label: Native
native.body: The model returns tool calls in the standard format, so agents work reliably.

repaired.label: Repaired
repaired.body: The model writes tool calls as text and Ylide converts them. Agents work, but a call may need a retry now and then.

failed.label: Failed
failed.body: The self-test did not produce a usable tool call. Agents may not work with this model; chat and inline edits are not affected.

active.commandLineHint: Exactly how the server was started
active.noCommand: No local process: Ylide talks to the external server directly.
active.logFailed: The server log could not be loaded: {{message}}
active.logEmpty: The server has not written anything yet.

installed.title: Installed models
installed.description: Model files on this computer and what each one is used for.
installed.importFailed: The file could not be imported.
installed.emptyBody: Download one from the catalog below or import a GGUF file.
installed.deleteBody: The model files ({{size}} GB) are removed from this computer.
installed.forgetBody: Ylide forgets this model. The file stays where it is; nothing is deleted.
installed.deleteActive: This model is running. It is stopped first.
installed.deleteAssigned: Where it is chosen for chat, autocomplete or code search, the choice is cleared.
installed.deleteAgain: You can download it again from the catalog.

vision.label: Understand images (+{{size}} GB)
vision.downloadFailed: The image module could not be downloaded. Switch it on again to retry.
vision.missing: The image module is missing; the model runs without image input.
vision.failed: The image module did not load; the model runs without image input.
vision.pending: Takes effect the next time the model starts.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: Running, paused and failed downloads. Paused downloads continue where they stopped.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description_one: {{count}} model from the Ylide model list, checked for local use.
catalog.description_other: {{count}} models from the Ylide model list, checked for local use.
catalog.none: No model in the list has this role.
catalog.paramsMoe: {{total}}B total, {{active}}B active per token (mixture of experts)
catalog.downloadsOff: Model downloads are switched off in Network and privacy.
catalog.downloadsOffNote: Model downloads are switched off. Switch them on in Network and privacy to download from the catalog.
catalog.noSpace: Not enough free disk space ({{free}} GB free).
catalog.recFailed: The recommendation could not be calculated: {{message}}
catalog.recNone: No model in the list fits this computer well.

uncensored.title: Uncensored variants
uncensored.note: Uncensored variants are versions of models in the list above with the refusal training removed. They also answer requests that the original declines. Ylide never picks them on its own, and how well they code and use tools has not been measured independently.
uncensored.badgeHint: Refusal training removed. Ylide never picks this model on its own.

own.title: Not in the list?
own.body: Use any GGUF model file from this computer.

runtimes.title: Runtimes
runtimes.description: The llama.cpp builds that run models. Ylide picks the best one for your hardware unless you choose one.
runtimes.loadFailed: The runtimes could not be checked: {{message}}
runtimes.fixed: You chose {{variant}}. Ylide uses it even if a better runtime is available.
runtimes.downloadsOff: Runtime downloads are switched off in Network and privacy.
runtimes.applyHint: A different runtime is used the next time the model starts.

registry.title: Model list
registry.description: The list of models, quantizations and checksums the catalog is built from.

originHint.bundled: The list that came with this version of Ylide.
originHint.cache: A newer list that was downloaded earlier.

registry.refreshHint: Checking downloads only the model list, nothing else.
registry.upToDate: The model list is up to date.
registry.disabled: Model list updates are switched off in Network and privacy.
registry.disabledHint: Model list updates are switched off.
